001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.fleets;
002
003import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Conditions;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.FleetTypes;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.MemFlags;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.People;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd.SDResolution;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.FleetCreatorMission;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.FleetQuality;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.FleetSize;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.OfficerNum;
018import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.OfficerQuality;
019import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.MissionFleetAutoDespawn;
020
021public class PersonalFleetOxanaHyder extends PersonalFleetScript {
022        
023        public PersonalFleetOxanaHyder() {
024                super(People.HYDER);
025                setMinRespawnDelayDays(10f);
026                setMaxRespawnDelayDays(20f);
027        }
028
029        @Override
030        protected MarketAPI getSourceMarket() {
031                return Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
032        }
033        
034        @Override
035        public CampaignFleetAPI spawnFleet() {
036                
037                MarketAPI sindria = getSourceMarket();
038                
039                FleetCreatorMission m = new FleetCreatorMission(random);
040                m.beginFleet();
041                
042                Vector2f loc = sindria.getLocationInHyperspace();
043                
044                m.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.HUGE, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.DIKTAT, FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, loc);
045                m.triggerSetFleetOfficers(OfficerNum.MORE, OfficerQuality.DEFAULT);
046                m.triggerSetFleetCommander(getPerson());
047                m.triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
048                m.triggerSetPatrol();
049                m.triggerSetFleetMemoryValue(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SOURCE_MARKET, sindria);
050                m.triggerFleetSetNoFactionInName();
051                m.triggerPatrolAllowTransponderOff();
052                m.triggerFleetSetName("Askonia System Defense Armada");
053                //m.triggerFleetSetPatrolActionText("patrolling");
054                m.triggerOrderFleetPatrol(sindria.getStarSystem());
055                
056                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = m.createFleet();
057                fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(MissionFleetAutoDespawn.class);
058                sindria.getContainingLocation().addEntity(fleet);
059                fleet.setLocation(sindria.getPlanetEntity().getLocation().x, sindria.getPlanetEntity().getLocation().y);
060                fleet.setFacing((float) random.nextFloat() * 360f);
061                
062                return fleet;
063        }
064
065        @Override
066        public boolean canSpawnFleetNow() {
067                MarketAPI sindria = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
068                if (sindria == null || sindria.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED)) return false;
069                if (!sindria.getFactionId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) return false;
070                if (SDResolution.get() != null) return SDResolution.get().allowPersonalFleetRewpawns();
071                if (SDResolution.isAskoniaStandoffCompleted()) {
072                        return false;
073                }
074                return true;
075        }
076
077        @Override
078        public boolean shouldScriptBeRemoved() {
079                return false;
080        }
081
082}
